observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D5300' clearly visible. The lens has 'Nikon AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR' engraved on it.

Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with a label that reads 'Nikon DIGITAL CAMERA D5300', 'MADE IN THAILAND', 'NIKON CORP. JAPAN', and 'MADE IN THAILAND'. The label also shows '12V/1.2A', 'FC', 'EFL', and a serial number '2045753'.

Photo 2 shows the top of the camera with the lens attached. The lens barrel has 'Nikon DX VR' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G' visible. The camera has a mode dial, power button, and a wrist strap. The lens has focus and zoom rings with numbers 18, 24, 28, 35, 45, 55 visible.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear visible on the lens and body.

claims.claim: This is a Nikon D5300 DSLR Professional Camera working perfectly ok with no single fault.
claims.evidence: The camera is visible in photos, but there is no proof of functionality. No video or test shot is shown. The shutter count is not visible, and no signs of damage are clearly visible, but wear and tear are present.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter, sensor, or electronics may be faulty).
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a live view on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front element, under bright light to check for haze or fungus.

risks.risk: Camera may have a high shutter count or sensor issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count display on the camera screen or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having high shutter count

risks.risk: Camera may have water damage or internal issues not visible externally.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the camera's body and lens for signs of moisture or corrosion.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens front element under bright light.
Photo of the shutter count display or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.
Photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the camera body and lens for signs of moisture or corrosion.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
